question_text: The ledger is a book of
option_a: Original entry
explanation: The ledger is a book of final entry.

question_text: Which of the following is a principal book of accounts?
option_a: Sales day book
explanation: The ledger is the principal book of accounts.

question_text: An account is divided into
option_a: Debit side and credit side
explanation: An account has debit and credit sides.

question_text: The debit side of an account is the
option_a: Right side
explanation: The debit side is the left side.

question_text: The credit side of an account is the
option_a: Right side
explanation: The credit side is the right side.

question_text: Assets are recorded on the
option_a: Debit side
explanation: Assets are debit balances.

question_text: Liabilities are recorded on the
option_a: Debit side
explanation: Liabilities are credit balances.

question_text: Capital is recorded on the
option_a: Debit side
explanation: Capital is a credit balance.

question_text: Expenses are recorded on the
option_a: Debit side
explanation: Expenses are debit balances.

question_text: Income is recorded on the
option_a: Debit side
explanation: Income is a credit balance.

question_text: Which of the following is a real account?
option_a: Cash account
explanation: Cash is a real account.

question_text: Which of the following is a nominal account?
option_a: Cash account
explanation: Rent is a nominal account.

question_text: Which of the following is a personal account?
option_a: Debtor's account
explanation: Debtor's account is a personal account.

question_text: The rule for real accounts is
option_a: Debit what comes in, credit what goes out
option_b: Debit the receiver, credit the giver
explanation: Real accounts: debit what comes in, credit what goes out.

question_text: The rule for nominal accounts is
option_a: Debit expenses and losses, credit income and gains
option_b: Debit what comes in, credit what goes out
option_c: Debit the receiver, credit the giver
explanation: Nominal accounts: debit expenses, credit income.

question_text: The rule for personal accounts is
option_a: Debit the receiver, credit the giver
option_b: Debit what comes in, credit what goes out
explanation: Personal accounts: debit the receiver, credit the giver.

question_text: A trial balance is a
option_a: List of debit and credit balances in the ledger
explanation: A trial balance lists debit and credit balances.

question_text: The primary purpose of a trial balance is to
option_a: Test the arithmetical accuracy of the ledger
explanation: A trial balance tests arithmetical accuracy.

question_text: A trial balance that does not agree indicates
option_a: An error in the ledger
explanation: Disagreement indicates errors.

question_text: Which of the following errors will NOT affect the trial balance?
option_a: Error of omission
explanation: Errors of omission do not affect the trial balance.

question_text: An error of omission occurs when
option_a: A transaction is completely omitted from the books
option_b: A transaction is recorded in the wrong account
option_c: A transaction is recorded with the wrong amount
option_d: A transaction is recorded in the wrong class of account
explanation: Omission is complete leaving out.

question_text: An error of commission occurs when
option_a: A transaction is recorded in the wrong account but of the same class
option_c: A transaction is recorded with the wrong amount
option_d: A transaction is recorded in the wrong class of account
explanation: Commission is wrong account of same class.

question_text: An error of principle occurs when
option_a: A transaction is recorded in the wrong class of account
option_c: A transaction is recorded in the wrong account of the same class
option_d: A transaction is recorded with the wrong amount
explanation: Principle is wrong class of account.

question_text: An error of original entry occurs when
option_a: A transaction is recorded with the wrong amount in the books of original entry
option_c: A transaction is recorded in the wrong account
option_d: A transaction is recorded in the wrong class of account
explanation: Original entry is wrong amount.

question_text: Which of the following is a compensating error?
option_a: An error that is offset by another error
option_b: An error that affects the trial balance
explanation: Compensating errors offset each other.

question_text: A suspense account is used to
option_a: Record the difference in the trial balance temporarily
explanation: Suspense account temporarily holds the difference.

question_text: Which of the following errors affects the trial balance?
option_a: Error of addition in the trial balance
explanation: Addition errors affect the trial balance.

question_text: Which of the following errors does NOT affect the trial balance?
option_a: Error of omission
option_c: Error of posting a wrong amount on one side
option_d: Error of recording a transaction twice
explanation: Omission does not affect the trial balance.

question_text: Which of the following errors affects the trial balance?
option_a: Error of posting a wrong amount on one side
explanation: Posting wrong on one side affects the trial balance.

question_text: Which of the following errors does NOT affect the trial balance?
option_a: Error of commission
option_c: Error of posting a wrong amount on one side
option_d: Error of recording a transaction twice
explanation: Commission does not affect the trial balance.

question_text: Which of the following errors affects the trial balance?
option_a: Error of recording a transaction twice
explanation: Recording twice affects the trial balance.

question_text: The trial balance is prepared
option_a: At the end of the accounting period
option_b: At the beginning of the accounting period
option_d: Only when there is a loss
explanation: Trial balance is prepared at period end.

question_text: A debit balance in the trial balance indicates
option_a: An asset or an expense
explanation: Debit balances are assets or expenses.

question_text: A credit balance in the trial balance indicates
option_a: A liability or income
explanation: Credit balances are liabilities or income.

question_text: Which of the following is included in the trial balance?
option_a: Debit and credit balances from the ledger
explanation: Both debit and credit balances are included.

question_text: Which of the following is NOT included in the trial balance?
option_a: Closing stock
explanation: Closing stock is not in the trial balance (unless adjusted).

question_text: Which of the following is included in the trial balance?
option_a: Opening stock
explanation: Opening stock is included in the trial balance.

question_text: An error of principle occurs when
option_a: Revenue expenditure is treated as capital expenditure
option_c: A transaction is recorded in the wrong account of the same class
option_d: A transaction is recorded with the wrong amount
explanation: Treating revenue as capital is an error of principle.

question_text: Which of the following is an example of an error of principle?
option_a: Recording the purchase of a fixed asset in the purchases account
option_b: Recording a sale in the wrong customer's account
explanation: Fixed asset in purchases is an error of principle.

question_text: Which of the following is an example of an error of commission?
option_a: Recording a sale to John in Mary's account
option_b: Recording the purchase of a fixed asset in the purchases account
explanation: Wrong personal account is an error of commission.

question_text: Which of the following is an example of an error of omission?
option_a: Omitting a transaction entirely
option_b: Recording a sale in the wrong customer's account
option_c: Recording the purchase of a fixed asset in the purchases account
explanation: Complete omission is an error of omission.

question_text: Which of the following is an example of an error of original entry?
option_a: Recording a sale of N500 as N50 in the sales day book
option_b: Recording a sale to John in Mary's account
option_c: Recording the purchase of a fixed asset in the purchases account
explanation: Wrong amount in original entry.

question_text: Which of the following is an example of a compensating error?
option_a: Recording a purchase of N500 as N50 and a sale of N500 as N50
option_b: Recording a sale to John in Mary's account
option_c: Recording the purchase of a fixed asset in the purchases account
explanation: Two errors offset each other.

question_text: Which of the following is a limitation of the trial balance?
option_a: It does not reveal all errors
explanation: The trial balance does not reveal all errors.

question_text: Which of the following is a limitation of the trial balance?
option_a: It does not prove the accuracy of the ledger
option_b: It proves the accuracy of the ledger
explanation: It does not prove accuracy.

question_text: Which of the following is a use of the trial balance?
option_a: It is used to prepare the final accounts
option_b: It is used to record transactions
option_c: It is used to correct errors
option_d: It is used to prepare source documents
explanation: The trial balance is used to prepare final accounts.

question_text: Which of the following is a use of the trial balance?
option_a: It tests the arithmetical accuracy of the ledger
explanation: It tests arithmetical accuracy.
